name: kedi-vscode
description: LSP-powered language support for Kedi DSL: highlighting via semantic tokens (tree-sitter on the server), diagnostics, hover, go-to-definition, references, rename, outline, signature help, inlay hints, formatting, plus Python LSP feature forwarding inside fenced ```python``` blocks.

kedi.lsp.usePythonExtension.description: Use the Microsoft Python extension's selected interpreter instead of the shared ~/.kedi/editor-venv. Kedi must already be installed there. Interpreter changes restart the server.

kedi.lsp.pythonPath.description: Explicit host Python executable, overriding the managed environment and Python extension selection. Kedi must already be installed there; no packages are installed into host environments.

kedi.lsp.serverCommand.description: Advanced server command override, used only when neither pythonPath nor usePythonExtension is set. Empty uses the shared managed Python environment.

kedi.lsp.trace.server.description: Trace level for the LSP client/server channel (visible in the 'Kedi Language Server' output panel).

kedi.codemode.preloadWarningThreshold.description: Warn when a static CodeMode preload_tools list contains more than this many unique tools. This is a lint threshold, not a runtime limit.

kedi.embeddedPython.enable.description: Forward Hover / Go-to-Definition / Find References to the Python language server (Pylance/Pyright) when the cursor is inside a fenced ```python``` block or a backtick `python_expr` region.

kedi.embeddedKediInPython.enable.description: Enable Kedi diagnostics, hover, go-to-definition, and references inside Python function docstrings whose first cleaned line is `kedi`.

kedi.embeddedKediInPython.experimentalSe.description: Provide Kedi semantic token highlighting inside Python docstrings whose first cleaned line is `kedi`.
